decisions.reason: The cleaning soap complements the core flooring offer at low cost, and with industry turnover growing and the firm hiring there is enough slack and no shortfall to trigger search for alternatives.
The maintenance oil supports the oiled-floor system and customer relationships, and satisfactory performance in a growing market gives management no reason to drop it.
The care product for oiled floors fits the established offer, and although it partly overlaps with A and B, its low carrying cost and the firm's slack favour keeping it.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory to the floors installers buy, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
The high-density underlay foam extends the accessory range at modest cost, and with no evidence of a shortfall and the firm having slack it is retained.
Oak parquet is core business for a wood flooring maker and very likely meets aspiration levels, so it is kept.
